blocks.text: Liquid ke khule surface se nikalne wale molecules upar ki hawa mein mil jate hain. Agar container (bartan) khula ho to yeh molecules nikalte hi rehte hain. Lekin agar container band kar dein to molecules surface ke upar jama hone lagte hain. Yeh molecules container ki deewaron se aur liquid ke surface se bhi takrate hain, aur ho sakta hai surface unhen wapas pakar le. Is process ko condensation (vapour ka wapas liquid banna) kehte hain. Evaporation aur condensation dono chalte rehte hain, yahan tak ke evaporation ka rate (raftar) condensation ke rate ke barabar ho jati hai (Figure 5.8).
Kisi khas temperature par apne liquid ke saath equilibrium (barabri ki halat) mein maujood vapour jo pressure dalta hai, use vapour pressure kehte hain.

Vapour pressure is baat par depend nahi karta ke container mein liquid kitna hai ya container ka volume kitna hai. Yeh liquid ke surface area par bhi depend nahi karta: bara surface area evaporation barhata hai, magar wapas aane wale molecules ke liye bhi bara target (nishana) banta hai, is liye condensation ka rate bhi utna hi barh jati hai.

blocks.alt: Teen band dabbe saath saath, har ek ke neeche dotted liquid aur liquid ki satah par arrows. (a) Liquid ke oopar vacuum (khala): chhe arrows oopar, molecules sirf nikalte hain. (b) Vapour: chaar arrows oopar aur do neeche, kuch molecules wapas aate hain. (c) Vapour: arrows bari bari oopar aur neeche, teen teen, yani evaporation aur condensation ki rate barabar.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.8: Evacuated (khali) band bartan mein liquid ke evaporation se equilibrium tak pohanchna. (a) Shuru ki halat, liquid ke oopar khali jagah, (b) beech ki halat, aur (c) equilibrium ki halat, jab evaporation ki rate condensation ki rate ke barabar ho.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: (a) shuru mein upar vacuum (khala) hai, molecules sirf nikal rahe hain. (b) kuch vapour jama ho gaya, kuch molecules wapas aane lage. (c) jitne nikalte hain utne hi wapas aate hain: equilibrium. Is waqt vapour ka pressure hi vapour pressure hai.

blocks.prompt: a) Har pair mein kis liquid ka vapour pressure zyada hai: (i) alcohol, glycerine (ii) petrol, kerosene (iii) mercury, water?
blocks.explanation: Jis liquid ki intermolecular forces kamzor hon woh asani se evaporate hota hai aur us ka vapour pressure zyada hota hai: (i) alcohol (glycerine ke teen O−H groups ke muqable ek), (ii) petrol (chhote molecules, kamzor London forces), (iii) pani (mercury ke atoms mazboot metallic bonding se jure hain).

blocks.prompt: b) Glycerine aur kerosene mein kaun zyada viscous hai?
blocks.explanation: Glycerine, kyunke us ke teen O−H groups bohat se hydrogen bonds banate hain; kerosene mein sirf London forces hain.

blocks.prompt: c) Ek hi temperature par acetone aur pani haath par dalne se acetone zyada thanda kyun lagta hai?
blocks.explanation: Acetone ke molecules ke darmiyan forces pani (hydrogen bonds) se kamzor hain, is liye acetone bohat tezi se evaporate hota hai aur skin (jild) se tezi se heat le jata hai.

blocks.prompt: d) Zyada temperature par evaporation tez kyun hoti hai?
blocks.explanation: Zyada temperature par zyada molecules ke paas itni kinetic energy hoti hai ke woh surface par attractive forces tor kar nikal saken, is liye har second zyada molecules ur jate hain.

items: Band container mein evaporation aur condensation ka rate barabar ho kar equilibrium banti hai; us waqt vapour ka pressure vapour pressure hai.
Vapour pressure liquid ki type aur temperature par depend karta hai; liquid ki amount, container ke volume ya surface area par nahi.
